summary: scripts/evidence-log.service raises TimeoutStartSec from 30min to 2h so a long backlog (19 h of records took 49 min 44 s on hetz2) can catch up in one run; the timer never starts a second run while one is active

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; nothing a verifier reads changes.

compatibility.detail: A host-side systemd unit setting only; no binary, claim or message format changes.

manual.detail: A host that already installed the unit copies the new scripts/evidence-log.service to ~/.config/systemd/user/ and runs systemctl --user daemon-reload; the running service is not restarted.

recovery.detail: Put the old unit file back and daemon-reload; no state changes.
